evolution_search.cases_per_candidate_semantics: 0 means all evolution cases in the current config; change only in a copied coverage config if a budgeted cap is chosen.

cost_estimate_basis.method: Scale calibrated real-pilot per-episode request, token and latency averages. Static uses validation episodes; customer-only uses evolution failure scan + three child evaluations + selected evaluation; coevolution uses three customer candidates, one replay policy, and a low/high range because the latest-attack filter may skip or admit replay/normal evaluation.
cost_estimate_basis.caveat: Planning estimate only; no provider price was available. It is not a measured result and must not be used as a statistical claim.

recommendation.reason: Use the smallest coverage option that still exercises multiple SOP paths, then add cases before adding generations. Reconfirm provider quota against the coevolution estimate in the runbook before launch.

fallback.condition: Only if the 3/1/3 request budget is not affordable; never fall back to 1/0/1 for a formal evolution claim.
